product_brief: A research fork of OpenSSL integrating post-quantum cryptography into TLS 1.2 and 1.3 for prototyping and experimentation.
pqc_capability_description: Integrates post-quantum cryptography into TLS 1.2 and 1.3 via a fork of OpenSSL 1.1.1 using liboqs. Supports hybrid and post-quantum key exchange and authentication. Includes algorithms FrodoKEM, SIKE, Picnic, and qTESLA. Intended for prototyping, experimentation, and evaluation; not for production use.
crypto_primitives: RSA, ECDH, ECDSA, AES, FrodoKEM, SIKE, Picnic, qTESLA
architecture_type: Hybrid (classical and post-quantum algorithms performed in parallel)
pqc_roadmap_details: Recommends using hybrid mode until the cryptographic community gains full confidence in new post-quantum cryptography. Notes that security of proposed algorithms may rapidly change.
